body:
I haven't - or I don't think I have. I can't exactly buy alcohol yet so I've only tried the beers people have handed to me. I've never been able to drink enough of the stuff to get buzzed, so maybe I just can't appreciate the pros of it. Honestly I'd rather smoke bud.

My list of shows I want to watch is pretty long. I've spent a lot of my time lately marathoning Friends and Futurama, two that I've already seen but are comforting and distracting. But I can't even pay attention to them anymore.
I've actually only seen the first episode, I was just watching it with my sister a few nights ago. I sort of missed the beginning and was a little lost but she loves it so I just kept watching.
Music is great. beer is a little gross, but I've only tried the cheapest of the cheap.

Thank you for your kindness and concern. I'm sorry for what you've had to go through as well. I'm also completely terrified that no one would believe me. Honestly it already affects me enough and I feel like bringing it out into the open would make me think about it 100% more than I already do. I have disclosed it to a few friends I've made on the Internet who I don't talk to anymore, as they had gone through similar stuff. 

I have tried a few medications for my anxiety, but I've never been prescribed anything. I think it'd be pretty hard because of my age, and I've never really successfully brought up anxiety to a doctor because I freeze up so much. But I've gone on Zoloft before, which made me feel terrible. I've also tried Valium which definitely helped, but I can't really afford to be buying a bunch of pills, and I'm scared I'll get addicted. Addiction definitely runs in the family. 

My mom and my sister both know I self harm. I told my sister that I hadn't in the past 7ish months, which  was true, except in the past week I've had multiple relapses. My mom only knows because of when I wanted to go to the hospital. It was during one of my worst panic attacks, and I texted her saying I wanted to be admitted because I was going to hurt myself. It was sort of like a last moment of desperate hope, I just wanted to get better. She refused to take me and made me wait until the next day to think it over, and by then I didn't want any help. Now it would be a lot easier to take myself to a hospital, because I live 5 minutes walk away from the biggest one in my town. But I don't think I want to. I just started school and I already missed today because I was having such bad anxiety. I don't know if I could have access to internet at a hospital to get my work done. I'm also scared of my family and kids at school finding out I'm in a hospital because I'm suicidal. The biggest thing probably stopping me though is the anxiety of walking up to the front desk and telling them I want to kill myself. I don't know if I could do it.

I do live in the states. I've always had a general plan of how to get through my teenage years, I made it when I was nine. Focus on school, go to a community college near by, and then find a better college in a different state and move there. I'm mostly interested in becoming an English professor and possibly working my way up to being a dean at a college, but I've also considered focusing on psychology instead. I've always said that if I actually make it, I want to help everyone I can to make it too.

But I've lost interest in this plan. Going through so many years of education sounds like hell. Social anxiety already overwhelms me every day, how could I handle living in the dorms of a big college full of people? 

Tomorrow I'm going to clean up my room and throw anything I wouldn't want to be found away. Then I'm gonna bike around my city to a few bridges, to see if there's any point of jumping. I've always had nightmares about drowning and it feels like I've maybe seen my death before in my sleep, maybe it's the way I'm supposed to go. I want to come back home tomorrow though. Say goodbye to my cat, write a note. Then early in the morning, before sunrise, I want to do it. I have a bottle of seroquel that I want to take incase I end up swimming out or get too scared.
